name: practice-sms-writer
description: Drafts one consent-first patient SMS (reminder / recall / update) for a health practice, grounded in the profile and consent record, AHPRA- and opt-out-firewalled. G2 — a human approves every send.
lifecycle_note: Adapted from coreyhaines31/marketingskills `sms`. Needs a golden set of real 20-80 practice SMS (reminder / recall / update, incl. opted-out and transactional-only cases) + an AHPRA violation test suite and a consent/opt-out test suite before it can enter shadow mode. Depends on the SMS connector for delivery.
